Advertisement for Engagement of Research Staff under ICSSR Sponsored Project
Applications are invited in the prescribed format from the suitable eligible candidates for the engagement of research staff on a
part-time basis for the following research positions under a purely time-bound ICSSR Research Project titled “Human
Security Challenges in Tribal Communities of Border Districts and Conflict Affected Areas of Jammu and Kashmir:
Pathways for National Stability”, under the Scheme Major and Minor Research Projects (2025-26) undertaken in the
Department of National Security Studies, Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Samba–181143 (Jammu and
Kashmir).
The details of the posts are as follows:

Terms and conditions:
v This temporary engagement will be for a specific period and services of research staff engaged on part-time basis will
automatically stand terminated either with the termination of the project/scheme or even before at the discretion of the
Project Director/Project Co-Director.
v The engagement will not entitle them any claim for regular employment in the University.
v Shortlisted candidates will be called for physical interview and they will be informed through email.
v The candidates called for interview are not entitled for TA/DA.
v The decision of selection committee will be final.
v Tenure of the assignment for the post at S. N.1 shall initially be for a period of 08 months and may be extended for a further
03 months.
v Tenure of the assignment for the post at S. N.2 shall initially be for a period of 04 months and may be extended for a further
02 months on need basis.
v The application form complete in all respects along with CV, self-attested copies of prescribed qualification certificates and
recent passport size photograph should reach the office of undersigned Department of National Security Studies, Central
University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Samba–181143 (Jammu and Kashmir), either as hard copy or by e-mail
to Prof. Venkataraman at venkatraman.nss@cujammu.ac.in on or before 20.09.2026 (by 11:59 PM). The application form
can be downloaded from the University website www.cujammu.ac.in.
v Shortlisted candidates for Interview will be intimated through email only.
v The competent authority reserves the right to fill up or not to fill the vacancies notified in this advertisement.
v For any further query please contact Project Director (9043515944) or Project Co-Director (9419255009).
